riskDescription: Deterioration of heritage masonry arch — risk of sudden spalling and partial structural failure under normal traffic loads.
potentialConsequence: Fatalities or serious injuries to road users. Bridge closure 6–24 months. Heritage loss.
likelihoodJustification: Ongoing mortar deterioration — condition rated Poor. Rate of decay accelerating.
consequenceJustification: Heritage significance and high daily traffic. No viable detour.
existingControls: Load limits gazetted at 12.5 t. Annual visual inspection. CCTV monitoring.
treatmentActions: Emergency repointing programme (FY2024/25 budget). Structural propping assessment. Heritage engineer engagement.
notes: This risk is EXTREME and requires Board-level awareness. Emergency allocation approved FY2024/25.

riskDescription: Scour erosion of spread footing foundation during 1:50 ARI flood event — foundation undermining risk.
potentialConsequence: Partial or full bridge collapse. Road network disruption. Potential downstream debris.
likelihoodJustification: 1:50 ARI event probability. Existing riprap provides partial protection.
consequenceJustification: Heritage asset. No viable detour. Collapse risk.
existingControls: Riprap installed 2019. Scour monitoring instrument. Post-flood inspection protocol.
treatmentActions: Annual scour depth survey. Enhance riprap to 1:100 ARI standard within 3 years.

riskDescription: Fatigue crack propagation in main arch hanger connections — risk of sudden hanger failure at mid-span.
potentialConsequence: Sudden partial deck collapse. Fatalities. Major economic disruption to Sydney CBD.
likelihoodJustification: Fatigue monitoring shows crack growth within design tolerance. Low probability within 5 years.
consequenceJustification: Critical infrastructure. Mass casualty potential. National economic impact.
existingControls: Biennial fatigue monitoring (strain gauges). Annual visual inspection. Hanger replacement programme.
treatmentActions: Accelerate hanger replacement programme. Increase monitoring frequency to quarterly.
notes: Ministerial briefing prepared. Risk accepted at current level — hanger replacement on accelerated schedule.

riskDescription: Inadequate barrier protection on approach span — sub-standard to current AS 3845. Risk of vehicle run-off during heavy rain events.
potentialConsequence: Vehicle run-off into Clarence River. Driver fatalities.
likelihoodJustification: Wet season rainfall events and narrow carriageway increase vehicle run-off probability.
existingControls: Speed advisory sign 60 km/h. Lane marking. Road surface in acceptable condition.
treatmentActions: W-beam barrier upgrade to TL-3 standard. Design to be completed Q1 FY2025.
notes: Barrier upgrade included in FY2025 Capital Works programme.

riskDescription: Potential for construction material leaching into Kangaroo River — non-compliance with NSW Water Management Act during maintenance works.
potentialConsequence: EPA enforcement action. Stop-work order. Penalty up to $250k. Ecological damage.
likelihoodJustification: Maintenance works scheduled. Low probability if environmental controls applied.
consequenceJustification: Regulatory breach — monetary penalty and reputational risk.
existingControls: Environmental management plan in place. Works permit obtained. Spill kit on site.
notes: Risk formally accepted at current residual level.
